text:
Anya: Quick sync — planning SDK v19 rollout tomorrow 2026-03-19 09:30 PT. Change: client auth header renamed to X-RW-Auth (breaking for older clients). Need deploy owner, smoke owner, rollback owner, and client comms owner. Who can take?

Matt: I can run the deploy. Proposal: 10m canary (small user slice) -> 10% for 20m -> full ramp if healthy. 09:30 PT works for me. :+1:

Sophia: I'll take smoke. Will watch streaming integrity, token refresh path, embeddings latency. I'll post a concise checklist and results.

Julian: I'll own client comms. Plan: integrator note + changelog. Also preparing a proxy shim to accept X-Old-Auth for 24h and emit Deprecation-Warn header.

Oliver: Rollback owner. I'll stage the revert and confirm the one-liner. Dry-run done. Revert command:
```
kubectl set image deploy/api api=redwood/api:release-v18.13 --namespace=prod
```

deploy-bot: Canary created by Anya: 2026-03-19T16:30:00Z -> 10m small canary -> 10% for 20m -> health gate -> ramp to 100%. Owners: Matt (deploy), Sophia (smoke), Oliver (rollback), Julian (client comms).

Sophia: Smoke checklist I'll use:
- curl POST /v1/generate (sync) with SDK token, expect 200 and coherent body
- open streaming session for ~80 tokens, verify chunk order & no gaps
- POST /v1/embeddings sample; compare latency vs baseline
- exercise SDK token refresh flow with expiring token
- verify Deprecation-Warn header on X-Old-Auth
- check telemetry: sdk.version, header_migration

Anya: Pre-deploy ops:
- confirm window (09:30 PT ok?)
- notify SRE & Support + post to #support-ops
- run staging preflight load script
- ensure feature flag and proxy toggles ready for instant rollback

sre-oncall: I'm on for the window. Setting alerts: 5xx rate >0.3% absolute OR >2x baseline, p95 latency >2x baseline. If triggered, I'll page and we consider rollback.

support-lead: I'll prepare a short FAQ and have the support channel on standby. Tagging the support team to monitor during the canary window.

Julian: Draft integrator note: "Header changed to X-RW-Auth. X-Old-Auth accepted for 24 hours post-cut; please migrate by 2026-03-20. See sample curl and troubleshoot steps." Will paste the draft for review here in 10m.

Oliver: Rollback ETA: ~5 minutes to flip image + proxy toggle. Confirmed: no DB migrations, artifacts pinned.

Matt: Abort criteria: any streaming integrity failure, 5xx spike >0.3%, p95 latency >2x baseline. If any threshold hit, we stop and rollback.

Sophia: I'll post smoke results here with timestamps. If we see issues, I'll call abort and tag @oliver to revert.

Anya: Final owners: Matt (deploy), Sophia (smoke), Oliver (rollback), Julian (client comms), Anya (coord). I'll notify support/sales and post the canary plan in #support-ops. Ping here when canary starts. Thanks!
